comparison.objective: Load four square blanks into a close-clearance gravity magazine.
comparison.physical_skill: Repeated grasping, planar squaring, close-clearance insertion, and stacking.
comparison.success_condition: Each blank wholly inside, flat, supported, centered, and at rest; score is loaded count over four.
comparison.reason: Although gravity and openings are involved, it tests individual precision insertion into one channel, not separating a mixture by inducing selective passage.
